calculation.description: Cross-sectional contrarian signal: negatively rank the prior 60-session return after annualized 60-session volatility normalization. The one-session lag ensures only completed data are used. Higher values indicate assets with weaker recent risk-adjusted momentum and are expected to have stronger subsequent 10-session returns.

validation.regime_notes: The inverted signal is positive and stable in 2025-2030 (IC 0.04830, ICIR 0.13596) and 2031-2035 (IC 0.04343, ICIR 0.13708), with stronger recent 180-day IC 0.08817 and ICIR 0.29196. Original, non-inverted risk-adjusted momentum was negative, motivating the explicitly contrarian direction. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation of uncertainty.
